config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu street views of Nanshan District, Shenzhen (one of four directions at each point), not the paper's images. Participants look at each street view for at least 10 seconds and score the 15 statements of the restorative perception scale (escape, extent, fascination, compatibility; based on Laumann's Restorative Components Scale) on the paper's seven-point scale from 0 (the statement does not match how you feel) to 6 (it matches completely), as the 25 university students and staff did in Han, Wang, He & Jung (2023, Frontiers in Public Health). Differences from the original study: 10 random views per participant; role (student, staff, other) is recorded.

paper.title: Restorative perception of urban streets: Interpretation using deep learning and MGWR models
